text:
maria-ibarra: Acme on Private deploy reporting intermittent 502s and TLS handshake failures to their private API endpoint over ExpressRoute. They also report BGP session flaps and spikes in latency. Can someone help triage?

netbot: Alert: BGP neighbor 10.10.10.1 -> DOWN at 2026-03-18T02:13Z (flaps: 3 in last 15m).

alex-chen: Looking. Can you get a traceroute + tcpdump from their edge, and any TLS/proxy error lines from our side?

maria-ibarra: Customer attached a pcap and traceroute. Traceroute output (excerpt):
```
1 10.1.0.1 0.9 ms
2 10.2.0.5 1.2 ms
3 192.168.0.1 12.4 ms
4 * * *
```
pcap shows multiple TLS ClientHello retransmits and ICMP Destination Unreachable, Fragmentation Needed (type 3 code 4).

kyle-oncall: ICMP frag-needed + '*' at hop 4 => probable MTU/PTMU issue. ExpressRoute/partner links often have smaller MTU than customer default. Ask them to try MSS clamping (1400) or reduce MTU on their router as a quick test.

alex-chen: Also worth validating BGP MD5 config; an intermittent MD5 mismatch can cause neighbor flaps when large updates/packets are exchanged. Can you paste the neighbor config (redact secrets) and `show ip bgp neighbors` output?

maria-ibarra: Customer says they configured MD5, but here's the snippet they provided (redacted):
```
router bgp 65001
 neighbor 10.10.10.1 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 10.10.10.1 password <redacted>
```
They also confirmed the flaps correlate with heavy HTTP uploads. Suspect both MTU and a config mismatch.

eng-infra: I ran a curl from our private peering host toward their endpoint and got intermittent `short read` / `tlsv1 alert internal error` in the proxy logs. When I reproduced with `--ipv4 --connect-timeout 5 -v`, I saw retransmits and `Connection reset by peer`.

alex-chen: Important checklist: 1) ensure ICMP type 3 code 4 (Fragmentation Needed) is allowed end-to-end so PMTUD works; 2) enable MSS clamping on the customer edge to 1400 as a quick mitigation; 3) confirm BGP MD5 values match on both sides; 4) if using IPsec fallback, verify UDP/500 and UDP/4500 allowed.

maria-ibarra: Asked customer to apply MSS clamp to 1400 and to re-check MD5. Also requested `show ip bgp neighbors` and a short tcpdump with DF bit set: `tcpdump -n -s 0 -w out.pcap 'tcp and (host <our_peer> or host <their_edge>)'` so we can see DF behavior.

netbot: Update: BGP neighbor 10.10.10.1 -> UP at 2026-03-18T03:01Z.

kyle-oncall: If it recurs, ask for a targeted repro: send progressively larger TCP payloads with DF set and small MTU to trigger frag-needed. Also recommend stable BGP timers and explicit MD5 rather than automated secret sync. Example suggestions: `neighbor 10.10.10.1 timers 30 90` and verify `show interface` MTU along the path.

maria-ibarra: Customer confirmed enabling MSS clamp fixed the TLS handshake errors and, after correcting a typo in the neighbor MD5 string, BGP stopped flapping. They validated uploads and sustained connections. Marking this incident resolved for now. :tada:
